scheduler: Kubernetes scalar Jobs using retained institutional PVC/security surface

qualification.restart_comparison: Four uninterrupted updates versus two plus same-image healthy checkpoint resume plus two updates
qualification.restart_equality: Exact model, optimizer, sampler/thinning position and Python/NumPy/CPU/CUDA RNG continuation
qualification.completion: Application receipt, exact source and runtime identity, terminal lifecycle evidence and output readback all pass

checkpoint_retention.permitted_deletion: Only redundant checkpoint.pt payloads newly generated within this exact study/trajectory, after latest-complete readback and immutable retirement receipt

fitting.admission: Same-source qualified worker; exact fold-native inputs; separate scheduler reservation; current quota and aggregate storage reservation; worker input identities and write/readback/removability checks
fitting.input_exit: Recheck exact same-worker file identities after completion; payload SHA-256 checked by the retained reader on consumption; no second raw-data reconstruction

storage.planning_basis: One16-GiB qualification plus ten4-GiB subset fits; measured publications must fit each cap without automatic expansion

scope_interpretation: Fresh fold-specific observation-model fitting for the already authorized retrospective frontier search; not predictor assessment or independent biological validation
